decisions.reason: The required About-page prize-copy change is already fully represented by its message-158 MODIFY.
The Big Block winner-count and draw-condition changes are already fully represented by its message-158 MODIFY; the $6,000 prize amount remains unchanged.
The Small Block winner-count and sales-trigger changes are already fully represented by its message-158 MODIFY; the $900 prize amount remains unchanged.
Changing block-prize parameters does not change the current or planned product names.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies, not how book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets behave after NFT transfer.
The $10 coded-referral commission amount, recipient, timing, and payout behavior remain unchanged.
The source changes block-prize parameters but does not alter Chainlink VRF, on-chain selection, fairness, or applicable draws.
The source does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations; no revised revenue allocation is specified.
The Small and Big Block mechanisms remain active, so their metadata counters, permanent badges, and referral-code metadata remain valid unchanged.
The source does not change the $48 flat royalty, its disclosure, its contribution to prize pools, or the rule that royalties do not create tickets.
The block-prize adjustment does not change the Transak provider, conversion asset, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies but does not resolve or modify whether prizes use manual claims or automatic payouts.
